title: 0282: the CLOSING THEOREM (CT) - precisely stated, gap quantified, mechanism space audited
summary: The entire RH program as localized by route (b) now reduces to ONE precisely stated theorem (design doc section 9, 'THE CLOSING THEOREM (CT)'): a configuration-independent, sup-form, pointwise bound on the unknown-side S-oscillation variation over the S-route pieces (P1 = [gData, t-1], P2 = [t+1, 16t w]) valid for ALL t >= tPT2, at or below the 0276 gate constants c*(t) (c*(tPT2) = 2.5821/2.5805/2.5809/2.5847, c*(t3) = 1.3445, c*(t4) = 1.2578, all in kernel-span-normalized fluc units; formal T4OffLO/T4OffLP strict rationals). CT would close every face window (t-1,t+1] for all t >= tPT2 and - with the known zero-free region below tPT2 - imply RH. What CT is NOT (audited 0275-0281): (1) not a published constant (best explicit |S(t)| at tPT2 is ~6.4-6.9, triangle piece ~12.85-13.8, 5.00x the gate; the 2024-2026 explicit-S literature is swept, 0280); (2) not obtainable under RH (Conrey-Ghosh-Gonek |S(T+H)-S(T)| <= (1/2+o(1)) log T/log log T is RH-conditional, gives ~4.27 at tPT2 = 1.65x above the gate, GROWING; a RH-conditional window closure is vacuous for RH - circularity); (3) not a mean-value statement (Trans 8571 moments control mean squares, not the pointwise sup the gate needs); (4) NOT BELOW THE FIRST MOMENT IN SUP FORM - STRUCTURALLY (0278/0281 wall): the unknown-side S-oscillation is a sum of like-sign (1/pi)-jumps (one per unknown zero) plus the smooth theta part, first moment dmain(t)*span(t) = 421.6/786.6/1259.9 in fluc units vs requirement 264.24/202.61/250.36, wall ratios 1.596/3.882/5.032 GROWING - a configuration-independent sup bound cannot beat its own first moment, so the true remaining gap after the 0281 correction is a 37% reduction below the first moment (5.00x published = 1.596x wall x 3.13x sup-overhead); (5) not data (the face is at infinitely many t, face zeros are conformant, fleet/wave data pins counts but cannot certify a configuration-independent forall-t bound, 0277 retraction stands). What CT IS: a theorem of strictly new strength - pointwise, sup-form, configuration-independent S-variation BELOW ITS OWN FIRST MOMENT, for all t above 3e12, for the unknown-zero S-oscillation. In subject language: a zero-density / pair-correlation result at h = 1 of RH-level strength. No such bound is known in a century of work; every S-theorem ever published bounds the sup ABOVE the first moment. Status: CT is the single open work item of the RH program; it is precisely stated, its gap quantified (37% below first moment, growing), and the mechanism space below it audited empty. Honest blocks: face OPEN, no zero-free claim, NO RH CLAIM.
statement: CT: exists a configuration-independent bound, valid for all t >= tPT2, with sup over conformant configurations of |S_unk(h) - S_unk(g)| (h,g in the day078 kernel pieces P1 = [gData, t-1], P2 = [t+1, 16t w], S_unk = (1/pi)-arg contribution of zeros with gamma > gData) <= c*(t); c*(tPT2) = 25821/10000 (sigma_A, T4OffLO gateA); then all face windows are empty for t >= tPT2 and RH follows.
gap: 37% below the first moment at tPT2 (ratio 1.596), growing (3.882 at t3, 5.032 at t4); the published-constant view (5.00x) decomposes as 1.596 (wall) x 3.13 (sup-overhead).
mechanismAudit: published constants: 5.00x miss; class/envelope kernel families: 3.2-4.9x; continuous R-vM S-tail: 10^12x; data wave: retracted 0277; spacing-only cancellation: structurally impossible without phase info; Conrey-Ghosh-Gonek: RH-conditional + 1.65x + growing (circularity + miss); Trans 8571 moments: mean-square, not pointwise sup; 2026 zero-free regions: sigma ~ 0.993 edge, cannot reach Re = 0.125227 face.
nextMoves: CT-1: attempt an explicit first-moment-sharpest theorem directly from the 1e-7-validated R-vM count + day078 kernel (this closes the 3.13x sup-overhead: 1321.29 -> 421.6 envelope, still 1.596x above the gate - documents the sharpest known SUP bound to the wall itself)

CT-2: quantify the Conrey-Ghosh-Gonek route exactly: under-RH |S-diff| at tPT2 (4.27 vs gate 2.5821 = 1.65x), and the exact unconditional form (Trans-type) of the h = 1 second moment - pin the minimal new ingredient needed (a pointwise extraction below the mean square, i.e. a zero-density input at unit scale)

CT-3: attempt a face-localized pair-correlation bound at h = 1 restricted to conformant (non-critical-line, Re ~ 0.125) zero configurations - the class where the first moment might be beatable by geometric constraints (spacing of the conformant band); if a sup over the CONFORMANT subclass (not all configurations) can be below 1.596x the mean, CT is reachable without RH-level input
CT-4: formalize each quantified gap in T4OffLQ once numerically pinned (strict rationals, per project convention)
honesty: NO RH CLAIM. No zero-free claim. Face OPEN. CT is stated as the open work needed, not as something proved or even known to exist.
